changelog:
Fixes for what v0.2.3's Plex tab could not do.

**Plex**
- "Use this server" now works. It did nothing at all in v0.2.3 — the button was
  wired to a guard that refused it, silently, with no error.
- Choosing a server now actually imports its films and shows. v0.2.3 added the
  source and stopped, and said importing was not built, which had stopped being
  true. If you added a Plex server on v0.2.3, remove it and add it again.
- The plex.tv/link address is a link you can tap. It is still shown in full,
  because signing in on a laptop that is already logged in is often easier.
- Sign-in and finding your servers worked in v0.2.3 and are unchanged.

**Still not proven**
- Playing a Plex item has never succeeded, because until now nothing got far
  enough to try. The catalog should be right; playback is the next thing likely
  to fail, and it will fail visibly rather than quietly.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build. Catch-up still has not been tested against a real provider archive.
